messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
["We're rebooting our SSL server due to recent upgrade on our security to serve you better.", 'We regret to inform you that we were unable to process your recent eBay account update.', "We'll send you a pack through the post which explains this in more detail.", 'You have 1 new secure message', 'the profile that you are using to access Abbey Financial Group Online Banking has been locked because of too many failed login attempts.', 'Thanks for your order, arnold@highwayman.com', 'Your two incoming mails were placed on pending status due to the recent upgrade to our database, In order to receive the messages Click Here To Confirm Your Account.', "This message is to alert you that you have a new response from customer care in your secure messages' area of your Internet Banking.", 'You have one new security message from ANZ Internet Banking', 'You have received this email because we have strong reason to believe that your PayPal account had been recently compromised.', 'This is the final concluding mention to inform you as of 18 - Sep - 2016 that you have not yet updated your iTunes ID details.', 'Your ad, titled "SONY PlayStation 3 METAL GEAR SOLID 4 PS3 80 GB BUNDLE!", has been posted as follows:<<link>> (electronics)', 'We are contacting you to remind you that on August 03, 2010, the Chase Security Department identified some unusual activity involving your Chase Card account.', 'Your Account is Suspended, Some information on your account appears to be missing or incorrect.', 'We detect irregular activity on your Halifax Internet banking account on 11/10/2010.', 'We re-writing to let you know that your online account has been temporarily suspended due to recent access to your account from an unknown IP address.', 'PetroSun Drilling Inc. DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
